title: HostBlockModel
description: Input MODEL for bodesign_c03_emit_host_block_diagram. Mirrors PartitionModel contract.

title.description: Diagram title. Defaults to 'Host Block Diagram' when absent.

peripherals.description: Peripheral blocks radiating from center. Empty array fails validation.

side.description: Which side of center this block sits on (required; invalid value -> missing_fields).

bus.description: Optional bus/interface label rendered on the connecting line.

type.description: Glyph type (memory/power/connector/phy/sensor/rf/...). Unknown -> dashed placeholder + listed in placeholders[].

reference_baseline.description: Optional. Derived-product provenance: baseline name + diffs + sourcing gates. Absent -> no derived-from block rendered (no fabricated baseline).

diffs.description: Each line a concrete delta vs baseline (e.g. 'no Ethernet PHY', '5 module sockets via MIPI 5->1 mux').

sourcing_gates.description: Each line a pending sourcing/verification gate (honesty model).
